items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: He got together a bunch of older guys, like Panama Francis on drums, myself

ctx.x: Well I was with Cab Calloway with Milt Hinton. As a matter of fact I have a tape, would you like it? Yeah, I have a tape that was taken at one of the music schools. I won’t give them a plug. But Arnie Lawrence, you’ve heard of him.
